source_dataset: FABDEM v1.2 (Forests and Buildings removed Copernicus DEM)

technical_parameters.valid_pixel_coverage: 100% across Church Street domain (no nodata cells)

comparison_against_existing_skadi_dem.physical_interpretation: Existing Skadi DEM is an uncorrected SRTM C-band radar DSM exhibiting rooftop reflections from 4-7 story commercial buildings. FABDEM successfully stripped these rooftop artifacts, establishing a smooth bare-earth corridor profile.

regional_elevation_reference.justification: Valid macro-scale bare-earth baseline showing continuous descent from 917.4m (West) to 910.1m (East).

boundary_condition_sensitivity.justification: Provides regional baseline for domain boundary ray-tracing sensitivity.

curb_and_sidewalk_modeling.justification: Cell size (~30m) is >2x total street width; cannot resolve 150mm curbs or 1:50 transverse drainage slopes.

building_base_placement.justification: Individual building entrance thresholds require terrestrial survey validation.

detailed_ray_traced_terrain.justification: Physics solver requires sub-metre surface representation. Coarse raster cannot be ingested as microscale terrain.

classification_decisions.prohibition: Authoritative ground_z must not be created from FABDEM raster. Planar or field-surveyed terrain must be approved before physics simulation.
